validator.name: KoSIT Validator
validator.en16931Stylesheets: replaced by those of release 1.3.17 of the EN 16931 validation artefacts, byte for byte the files of this pack

deviations.cause: The official validator chooses its artefacts with a table of scenarios, each of which matches one exact customization identifier, and rejects a document that matches none of them before running anything. The syntax engine chooses per artefact instead: a document whose profile no rule set of the pack recognizes is still checked against the schema of its syntax, and against the EN 16931 rules where it says it follows EN 16931. This engine therefore reaches no verdict on such a document: it reports INDETERMINATE with the cause no-rules-for-profile, names the rule sets that were left out and why, and leaves with exit code 9. Both runs decline to call the document valid; they decline differently, one before looking and one after checking what applies.

No release of the XRechnung validator configuration carries release 1.3.17 of the EN 16931 validation artefacts yet; the one of 2026-08-31 ships a compilation of its own of release 1.3.16. The oracle was therefore run with that configuration and its two EN 16931 stylesheets replaced by those of release 1.3.17, the files this pack carries. Run with the configuration as published, the two answers differ on these documents, each by a change of the release: CII-SR-475 and CII-SR-476 no longer fire, and UBL-SR-59, a rule release 1.3.17 adds, fires on a document both runs reject already. The verdicts are the same either way.
